response.limits: This is a first-read draft for resident and attending review. It was read blind, with no indication and no dates. Only one frontal PA film per study was provided, with no lateral view. The images are downsampled and compressed, so fine detail such as nodule margins, calcification and subtle bone lesions is limited. No measurements were made, and size statements are by eye only.
